prompt_en: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a photorealistic vertical social photograph in a closed planetarium service corridor after hours. Treat Image 1 solely as a visible adult appearance reference: use only the portrait's visibly adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural facial texture, without an identity or same-person claim. The camera records the room-scale mirror reflection rather than a direct front-camera portrait. A vertical waist-up composition leaves both working hands, the mirror seam, the radio, and the phone legible together. The mirror has a readable edge, seam, and reflected-room depth. In one unfinished causal beat, one clearly adult woman with long dark wavy hair retunes a small pocket radio with one hand while her other hand visibly grips a matte black phone, checking the shared reflection as a clear notebook with blank star-chart shapes stays tucked beneath one arm. Specifically, a visible mirror edge thickness seam or reflected-room discontinuity establishes one physical reflective plane inside the planetarium corridor. Within it, one clearly adult subject's face hair and body appear inside that same reflected space beside the radio station. The reflected subject visibly grips one phone and the hand-to-device contact remains anatomically coherent during the unfinished tuning action. Reflection gaze phone placement and any facial occlusion agree with the mirror geometry across the visible seam. A direct selfie empty mirror detached phone phone-screen image or software border does not substitute for the room-scale physical reflection. On the face, bilateral cosmetic color occupies both upper cheeks directly below the lower eyelids in a soft rose hue. A narrow clean skin boundary keeps pigment outside the eye and lower-lid margin on both sides. The cheek pigment has controlled soft cosmetic edges and a readable blush hue under mixed corridor light. Dark circles fatigue shadow tears irritation and generalized redness do not substitute for the bilateral cosmetic distribution. Across the complexion, a thin cosmetic layer lightly evens broad complexion tone without opaque masking across the visible face. Pores fine texture and small surface irregularities remain visible through the correction at native inspection. Subtle local natural color variation remains instead of one uniform painted skin color across cheeks and forehead. Surface shine lighting and grading remain separate and literal transparency blur overexposure or plastic smoothing does not substitute for low cosmetic coverage. Dim amber practical lamps illuminate worn corridor surfaces while one cool phone flash reaches the face, hands, radio, and their reflection from a coherent direction. Relaxed asymmetric posture, a slightly slipped notebook, tiny handling marks on the radio, and incomplete tuning make the moment specific rather than posed. Slight sensor grain and unpolished moment-to-moment immediacy keep the result socially lived-in.
